result_review.interpretation: The supplied counts support ALL30_DEFINED_PASS: every eligible denominator is nonzero and every strict-gold-winner proportion exceeds one half, ranging from 64.76% to 73.58%. Thus, within each evaluated frozen-head CPU replay cell, a majority of gold-positive examples predicted null retain the correct unique ranking among the 39 nonnull classes. This is an error-ranking opportunity, not evidence that an implementable threshold policy can identify those examples without labels. Suppressing null would correct the counted winners but could also introduce false positives on true-null examples. The pattern appears in both classical controls and therefore does not establish a quantum-specific advantage.
